properties.description: Carga resultados de Silver a Gold usando claves sustitutas de las 6 dimensiones. Ejecutar después de cargar dimensiones. Requiere DS_Silver_Results y DS_Gold_Fact_RaceResults.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT  TRY_CONVERT(int, s.resultId) AS result_id,  dr.race_sk, dd.date_sk, dv.driver_sk, dc.constructor_sk, ci.circuit_sk, ds.status_sk,  TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.grid) AS grid_position,  TRY_CONVERT(smallint, NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(30), s.position))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS final_position,  TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.positionOrder) AS position_order,  TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,2), s.points) AS points,  TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.laps) AS laps_completed,  TRY_CONVERT(bigint, NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), s.milliseconds))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS race_time_ms,  CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), s.fastestLapTime))), \'\\N\'), \'\'))) IS NOT NULL  THEN DATEDIFF(millisecond, CAST(\'00:00:00.000\' AS time(3)), TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), s.fastestLapTime))), \'\\N\'), \'\')))) END AS fastest_lap_ms,  TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,3), NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), s.fastestLapSpeed))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS fastest_lap_speed_kph,  CAST(CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int, s.positionOrder) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tinyint) AS is_win,  CAST(CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int, s.positionOrder) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tinyint) AS is_podium,  CAST(CASE WHEN ds.is_finished_flag = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tinyint) AS is_dnf,  CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.grid) > 0 AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.positionOrder) IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.grid) - TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.positionOrder) AS smallint) END AS positions_gained,  CASE WHEN dv.dob IS NOT NULL AND dr.race_date >= dv.dob THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(day, dv.dob, dr.race_date) / 365.2425 AS decimal(4,1)) END AS driver_age_at_race FROM silver.results s INNER JOIN gold.dim_race dr ON dr.race_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.raceId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_date dd ON dd.full_date = dr.race_date INNER JOIN gold.dim_driver dv ON dv.driver_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.driverId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_constructor dc ON dc.constructor_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.constructorId) INNER JOIN silver.races r ON TRY_CONVERT(int, r.raceId) = dr.race_id INNER JOIN gold.dim_circuit ci ON ci.circuit_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, r.circuitId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_status ds ON ds.status_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.statusId) WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, s.resultId) IS NOT NULL  AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.grid) IS NOT NULL  AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.positionOrder) IS NOT NULL  AND TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,2), s.points) >= 0  AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.laps) IS NOT NULL  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.fact_race_results f WHERE f.result_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.resultId))',
